tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get current pricing for the SoldComps.io API (eBay sold listings as JSON): the free plan, monthly plans, and pay-as-you-go credits with their fair-billing rules. Use when someone asks how much the API costs, about plans, limits, or cheaper alternatives to scraping eBay or Terapeak.

tools.description: Search SoldComps.io's sold comps guides: what sold comps are, how to find and read them, how many you need, sold vs active listings, median vs average, Best Offer prices, auction vs Buy It Now, fake sold prices, sell-through rate, eBay's sold-listings sign-in wall, Google Sheets, and category guides

tools.name: what_are_sold_comps
tools.description: A short, citable definition of sold comps (sold comparables) and how resellers use them to price items from real eBay sales. Use for 'what are comps / sold comps' questions.
